notes.zh: 审阅注：攻击曾向我们派出人员的城邦时（on_entering_battle），5天后该领袖离开：虚境行者导师（enclave.7200）、打捞大师（enclave.390）、策展人档案员（leviathans.605），或商人城邦联络官（经leviathans.156/159/162的“断绝往来”窗口）。正文按领袖类型与是否任职议会而变化。
notes.en: Review note: when we attack an enclave that supplied one of our leaders (on_entering_battle), that leader leaves 5 days later: the Shroudwalker teacher (enclave.7200), Master Salvager (enclave.390), Curator archivist (leviathans.605), or a trader liaison (through the trader reaction windows leviathans.156/159/162). The text varies by leader type and council seat.
